news.title: What do people in middle-income countries think about cuts to U.S. humanitarian aid?
news.summary_en: In 16 middle-income countries surveyed, many people are unsure how U.S. humanitarian aid cuts will affect them, though those with opinions lean negative.

news.title: U.S. foreign aid is plunging in second Trump administration
news.summary_en: U.S. foreign aid fell to its lowest inflation-adjusted level in over two decades in fiscal 2025, dropping to $47.3 billion — more than $24 billion less than the prior year.

news.title: How global energy production is changing, in 6 charts
news.summary_en: Fossil fuels still dominate global electricity, but wind and solar are surging. In 2025, renewables outpaced coal worldwide for the first time, supplying 34% of electricity.
